description_ru: Peat, 1-6 m, usually on fine-grained marine sediments
Fluvial: deltaic and estuarine sand and silt, terraces, floodplains
Littoral and nearshore: sand, gravel, cobbles, boulders, 0.5-10 m
Offshore (Tyrrell Sea): clayey silt and silty clay, up to 60 m
Sakami Moraine deposits: stratified sand and gravel, up to 40 m
Esker and subaqueous outwash: stratified sand and gravel
De Geer moraine complex: sandy till, outcrops and marine fines
Sandy basal till, drumlins and crag-and-tail, up to 25 m
Bedrock: Archean and Proterozoic, locally <1 m surficial cover
